notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.2.0
notes.content:
ADD: Controller support
ADD: Steam Achievements
ADD: Achievement menu
ADD: Mouse cursor graphics
ADD: New and improved Dress-Up menu
ADD: Gift priorities to avoid unrealistic overlaps

CHANGE: Affirmation language to be more consistent
CHANGE: Affirmation tooltip coloring to be clearer
CHANGE: New base affirmation texture and better text centering
CHANGE: New texture for empty affirmation slot
CHANGE: Stamina tank tooltip position
CHANGE: Default audio levels for better balance
CHANGE: Pause menu to separate settings and include achievements

FIX: 'Affirmations Ignored' statistic not counting
FIX: Affirmations rendering below Act of Service shop buttons
FIX: Affirmation tooltip being drawn too high before grabbed

notes.title: v0.1 is Available Now!
notes.content:
I am very excited to announce the launch of [i]Hand-Holding Simulator[/i] version 0.1! This is the first publicly available version of the game, and there is a long road ahead to continue improving it.

Your feedback will be essential to making [i]Hand-Holding Simulator[/i] as good as it can be. If you want to join the conversation, there's a [url=https://discord.gg/KKRC3Vwa]Discord Server[/url] for suggestions and bug reports.

Happy Holding!
